end.summary:
Discussed health as physical, mental and social well-being.
Initially linked health mainly with not having fever or illness.
Later identified sleep, loneliness, sadness and friendships as health factors.
Applied the idea to compare two people and suggest team activity and friendship support.
Formal teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the idea that health includes physical, mental and social well-being, not only the absence of disease. Siya first focused on fever and exercise, then corrected this by explaining how poor sleep, loneliness and sadness can affect health even when the body seems fine. At home, ask Siya to give one physical, one mental and one social example of being healthy.
